In compliance with the instructions of the D.C. (Special
Branch), Mr. S. T. Chow ( 周 守 之 ), Chairman of the
"Model Children's Dramatic Society," 27 Yui Ching Feng, North

under no circumstances to be staged in the Settlement.

pages.en:
Appendix "A"

A Sketch of Chapei

Time : March 15, 1937.
Place: A family on Paoshan Road.

The play depicts a family consisting of a mother,
two sons and a daughter, the father having been away from
home for a long time.

One day, when the daughter returns, she reports that
a man, poorly dressed, is standing outside the house. Later
the man comes in; it is the father of the family.

The elder son, however, does not recognize him as
the father, but calls him a Chinese traitor.

The elder son : "In that year of the "January 28" Incident,
he (the father) was a well known Chinese
traitor in Chapei. On behalf of the
x x, he bought over a number of "slaves
without a nation" to create disturbances
at the rear.

"You said that we are bound to support him
(the father). I, however, do not think
so. In order to earn money, he did
sell his personality and country and
become the running dog of the devils.
For our part, we should say that we have
no father.

"During the "January 28" Incident, he was more
or less the native king extorting money
and committing robbery, arson and murder.
When the Incident was over, he realized that
he could not stay in Shanghai and left
for the North East with his Japanese
sweetheart. In the North East, he chose
to be a dog. He did not care for the
welfare of the race, but only for his
passion."

Disappointed, the father leaves and the play is
thus concluded.
pages.zh:
附件“A”

《闸北小景》

时间：1937年3月15日。
地点：宝山路的一户人家。

该剧描写了一个由母亲、两个儿子和一个女儿组成的家庭，父亲长期离家在外。

一天，女儿回家后报告说，有一个衣着破旧的男人站在屋外。后来这个男人进来了；他是这家的父亲。

然而，大儿子并不认他为父，反而称他为汉奸。

大儿子：“在‘一·二八’事变那年，他（父亲）是闸北著名的汉奸。他代表 x x，收买了一批‘亡国奴’在后方制造骚乱。

“你说我们必须支持他（父亲）。但我却不这么认为。为了赚钱，他出卖了自己的人格和国家，成为了鬼子的走狗。对我们来说，我们应该说我们没有父亲。

“在‘一·二八’事变期间，他差不多是个土皇帝，敲诈勒索，犯下抢劫、纵火和杀人的罪行。事变结束后，他意识到无法在上海立足，便带着他的日本情妇去了东北。在东北，他甘愿做狗。他不关心民族的福祉，只关心自己的私欲。”

父亲失望地离去，剧终。

pages.en:
Appendix "B"

A Thief

Time - A winter
Place- a place near the factory zone.

The play begins with a family consisting of a
father and a daughter.

The father
while reading
an evening
paper :
"The devils again utilize the bandit armies
to invade Suiyuan.
"The devils are afraid of the unification of
China.

The daughter :
"Is it that this time we again refrain
from resisting?

The father :
"No, this time we resist; General Fu Tso-nyi
has already determined to resist the
enemy.

After selling a quantity of clothing to a second
hand goods dealer, the father leaves the house. Later a
thief appears and plays his part. He is soon caught by
the daughter who advises him to go away at once.

The thief :
"If I leave, will you call the police?

The daughter :
"No, I'll not. I can swear I'll not,
because I am in sympathy with those poor
people who have no food.

At that moment, the father returns and intends to send the
thief to the police.

The daughter :
"Papa, please release him. It is not
his fault, but the fault of society.

The play is concluded with the thief being
taken by the father to the Police.
pages.zh:
附件“B”

《小偷》

时间 - 冬季
地点 - 工厂区附近某处。

剧情开始于一个由父亲和女儿组成的家庭。

父亲
一边读
晚报
一边说：
“鬼子再次利用匪军入侵绥远。
“鬼子害怕中国的统一。

女儿：
“难道这次我们又不抵抗吗？

父亲：
“不，这次我们要抵抗；傅作义将军已决心抗敌。

父亲将一批衣物卖给旧货商后离家。随后一个小偷出现并实施盗窃。他很快被女儿抓住，女儿劝他立即离开。

小偷：
“如果我走了，你会叫警察吗？

女儿：
“不，我不会。我可以发誓我不会，
因为我同情那些没有饭吃的穷人。

就在那时，父亲回来，打算将小偷送交警方。

女儿：
“爸爸，请放了他。这不是
他的错，而是社会的错。

剧情以父亲将小偷带往警察局而告终。

In accordance with the instructions of the D.C. REPORT
File No: REGISTRY

Branch / XXXXXX 37
Date March 13. 19. 37.

Subject "Model Children's Dramatic Society" (模範兒童劇社)
- in the course of formation.

Made by U.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by J. Boyce O.S.I

A new organization to be known as the "Model Children's
Dramatic Society" is in the course of formation with a
communication address at the Yeu Tuh (友德) Primary School,
27 Yui Ching Fong (餘慶坊), North Szechuen Road, U.O.L.
The following are the principal promoters :-
Chow Shou-ts (周守之),
a teacher of the Yeu Tuh Primary School.
Koh Ye-ping (谷似萍),
an editor of the Tung Nan Evening News.
53/5 Avenue Edward VII (French Concession) and
the "Model Children Monthly", 27 Yui Ching
Fong, North Szechuen Road, U.O.L.
Chi Siao-noong (计笑濃),
an editor of the "Model Children Monthly".
It is now engaged in canvassing members. Up to the present,
five children have enrolled with the society as members.
When properly organized, the society plans to stage
plays in primary schools in Shanghai on Saturday afternoons
for educational purposes.
According to the promoters, the first two plays to
be rehearsed will be entitled "The Thief" (小偷) and
"A Sketch of Chapei" (北小景). Passages in the script of
the play "The Thief" are of an anti-Japanese nature. The
script of the play "A Sketch of Chapei" is not available.
The promoters claim that these plays will be sent to the
Bureau of Social Affairs for censorship prior to their
publication.

（左侧手写批注：Better warn them in advance that (a) plays for Schools produced under form approval of S.A.P (b) No political propaganda under any circumstances）

S.I.
Kao Yen-ken
U. S. I.
(印：SPECIAL BRANCH 13 MAR 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE)

一个名为“模范儿童剧社”的新组织正在组建中，通讯地址为北四川路余庆坊27号友德小学（U.O.L.辖区）。主要发起人如下：
周守之（Chow Shou-ts），
友德小学教师。
谷似萍（Koh Ye-ping），
《东南晚报》编辑。
爱德华七世大道53/5号（法租界）及

计笑濃（Chi Siao-noong），
《模范儿童月刊》编辑。

已有五名儿童登记入社。

S.I.

March 4, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

Iron News (鐵報) published the following article on Mar.3s

THE MODEL CHILDREN'S DRAMATIC SOCIETY

An organization known as the "Model Children's
Dramatic Society" (模範兒童劇社) will soon be formally
inaugurated by members of the "Model Children's Monthly
Publishing Agency" (模範兒童月刊社). Most of the members
are students or teachers of primary schools in Shanghai.
This dramatic society will stage plays in
primary schools on Saturday afternoons in order to arouse
the interest of teachers and students to dramatic plays.

"A Sketch of Chapei" to be Staged

The new society is canvassing members and will
be formally inaugurated at a meeting to be held in the near
future.
According to Mr. Chow Shou Ts (周守之), a
responsible official of the society, the first performance
to be given will include two one-act plays entitled "The
Thief" (小偷) and "A Sketch of Chipei" (閘北小景),
both of which were written by Mr. Lu Sz (魯思).
The temporary communication address of the
dramatic society will be c/o the Yeu Tuh Primary School
(友德小學), No.27 Yui Ching Fong (餘慶坊), North Szechuen
Road.

（批：1? mB - 5 MAR. 1937）

S.I.
Jmanenin
Dor

1937年3月4日。
下午译文。

《铁报》于3月3日刊登了以下文章

模范儿童剧社

一个名为“模范儿童剧社” (模範兒童劇社) 的组织即将由“模范儿童月刊社” (模範兒童月刊社) 的成员正式成立。其成员多为上海各小学的学生或教师。
该剧社将于周六下午在小学演出剧目，以激发师生对戏剧的兴趣。

将上演《闸北小景》

该新社团正在招募会员，并将在近期举行的会议上正式成立。
据该剧社负责人周守之先生称，首场演出将包括两部独幕剧，题为《小偷》和《闸北小景》 (原文误拼为Chipei)，均由鲁思先生撰写。
该剧社的临时通讯地址为北四川路余庆坊27号友德小学转交。

（批：1? mB - 1937年3月5日）

S.I.
